Haruna Arakawa ( 荒川 晴菜 , Arakawa Haruna ; born 27 October 1999 in Edogawa, Tokyo ) [ 1 ] is a Japanese tennis player. Her career-high singles ranking by the Women's Tennis Association is world No. 352, which she achieved on 10 February 2020. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] Her career-high doubles ranking is 240, achieved on May 22, 2023. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] Career [ edit ] Haruna Arakawa began playing tennis at age 5, and she turned pro in April 2017. [ 1 ] According to her ITF profile, she prefers playing on hardcourt . [ 2 ] She primarily competes on the ITF Women's World Tennis Tour , where she has won four singles and 12 doubles titles.
